Tia (docs): Heads up — I'm landing a small docs change to cover structured-output rescue flows for tool-calling: nested arrays, missing optional fields, and the runtime shim. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1580
Sam (eng-runtime): Add the telemetry note: runtime emits `parse_shim_applied` and sets route flags `parsed` and `parse_shim_applied` so callers can detect fallback paths.
Jordan (devex): I'll add a streaming-safe JS example and a short unit test prompt: "Return actions as [[{"name":"x"}]]" so QA can repro.
Maria (sdk): JS snippet I propose:
```js
const r = await client.responses.create({model:'rw-open-7b', input: prompt});
try { const data = JSON.parse(r.output_text); } catch { const data = client.responses.parse_shim(r.output_text); }
```
Chad (product): Also include a brief note for Dedicated customers about potential small retry latency and recommended prefix caching.
deploy-bot: Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.dev/docs/1580 (checks: lint ✓, link-checker ⚠ anchors)
Tia (docs): I'll update PR with snippets, prompt, telemetry and product blurb; will fix anchors. Target merge tomorrow AM. :shipit:
file_notes: Slack coordination thread for docs PR on parser shims/rescue flows, SDK snippets, telemetry, and link fixes. Short, conversational Slack style with code snippets and a preview link.
